description: Adaptive Surface 0.11.1 corrects the decorative-only 0.11.0: normal upright placement footprint, separately hittable entities, protected supports and no decorative prompts. Existing saved decorations migrate on load.
changes: Separate the normal upright, grid-aligned placement footprint from the inclined visual extent and clicked point; remove the artificial eight-unit cap.
Add RespondToHit because native 0.7.2 combat selectors reject a visual entity with Interactable alone.
Handle positive direct Damage after filters; preserve cancelled hits and exactly-once item ownership. Redirect mining hits to the decoration when its oriented box is in front of the block.
Protect the support for 0.4 seconds from the parallel block-breaking tail of the same swing.
Remove decoration messages and hints; use empty BlockType hint because processConfig replaces null with the generic prompt.
Restore hit eligibility and quiet interactions for entities saved with the real 0.11.0 JAR.
advantages: Normal-size objects no longer require additional empty cells merely because they are tilted
Decorations can be removed by hitting them separately from the surface
Uses native markers and events without adding health, NPC behavior, new texture assets or client patches
disadvantages: Still decorative only; functional chests, doors, benches and plant growth remain deferred
Live client input/visual acceptance is still pending
Tilted visible extent may overlap the normal logical placement envelope; no universal third-party compatibility guarantee
test_results: Offline Gradle check/build passed 278606 existing assertions
Four 0.11.1 native boots passed placement, combat eligibility, mining redirection, direct damage/refund, save/reopen and shape regressions
Two additional boots saved real 0.11.0 entities and reopened them with 0.11.1; RespondToHit and quiet hints verified
1720 compared existing resources unchanged; no new model/texture/catalogue assets
Installed 0.11.1 SHA-256 371de15689a0068564ddf6d11e64d8e188a2d680916242f47bdd9f4295f6ac96; prior JAR backed up; no player save edits

source_refs.description: User-reported regressions, native contracts, six isolated boot checks and installation.
